title: Where should you move?
summary: Eight cities ranked by the weights you set.

ranked.sql: SELECT *, s_cost + s_sun + s_transit + s_safety AS score FROM (SELECT city, country, rent_usd, sun_hours, transit, safety, $w_cost * (max(rent_usd) OVER () - rent_usd) / nullif(max(rent_usd) OVER () - min(rent_usd) OVER (), 0) AS s_cost, $w_sun * (sun_hours - min(sun_hours) OVER ()) / nullif(max(sun_hours) OVER () - min(sun_hours) OVER (), 0) AS s_sun, $w_transit * (transit - min(transit) OVER ()) / nullif(max(transit) OVER () - min(transit) OVER (), 0) AS s_transit, $w_safety * (safety - min(safety) OVER ()) / nullif(max(safety) OVER () - min(safety) OVER (), 0) AS s_safety FROM cities) ORDER BY score DESC
